# Master Patterns

> Master Patterns is a modern Computer Science (CS) Pattern Learning Platform & Visualizer. It provides interactive step-by-step visual tracing, in-browser JavaScript sandbox execution, and multi-language code generation (C, C++, Java, Python, JavaScript) for classic and advanced matrix/symbol pattern programs.

Website: https://master-patterns.vercel.app/
Developer: Asifur Rahaman (https://asifur-rahaman-portfolio.vercel.app/)

## Core Routes & Applications

- [Catalog](https://master-patterns.vercel.app/): Interactive catalog of 26 CS pattern programs with category filters, difficulty tags, live canvas previews, and custom symbol replacements.
- [Report an Error / Feedback](https://master-patterns.vercel.app/report): Web3Forms-integrated error reporting tool for reporting code syntax errors, rendering issues, or suggesting new patterns.
- [Sitemap](https://master-patterns.vercel.app/sitemap): Descriptive platform index, pattern categorization matrix, and architecture specifications.

## Pattern Categories (26 Total Patterns)

- **Star Patterns**: Classic right-angled pyramids, inverted triangles, diamonds, hourglasses, butterfly patterns, and hollow stars.
- **Number Patterns**: Incrementing pyramids, Pascal's triangle, Floyd's triangle, palindromic number pyramids, Binary (0-1) triangles, and symmetrical Number Crown bridges.
- **Character / Alphabet Patterns**: Repeated letter pyramids, A-Z sequence grids, continuous alphabet triangles, and reverse alphabet triangles.
- **Pyramid & Diamond Patterns**: Centered symmetrical pyramids, odd star pyramids (2*i - 1), inverted odd pyramids, and geometric hollow diamonds.
- **Advanced Matrix Patterns**: Concentric number squares (distance-to-boundary matrix algorithm), hollow squares, and mathematical heart shapes.

## Code Generators & Developer Tools

Master Patterns generates production-grade, formatted source code with configurable loop variables, space padding, and row parameters across 5 programming languages:
- **C** (`stdio.h`)
- **C++** (`<iostream>`)
- **Java** (`System.out.print` with dynamic class naming matching file specifications)
- **Python** (`print()`)
- **JavaScript** (`console.log`)

### Interactive Learning Capabilities
- **Line-by-Line Code Breakdown**: Every line of code includes educational annotations detailing loop counters, spacing math, and character printing.
- **Live In-Browser Code Playground**: Sandbox code runner powered by isolated Web Workers with a 1.5-second watchdog timer protecting against infinite loops.
- **One-Click File Export**: Direct local file downloader for `.c`, `.cpp`, `.java`, `.py`, and `.js` source files.
- **Step-by-Step Execution Visualizer**: Visual frame-by-frame animation player showing nested loop execution row-by-row.

## Technical Specifications

- **Frontend Stack**: React 19, Vite 8, Vanilla CSS Design System with dark and hazy bluish-pink light mode themes.
- **Routing**: Client-side HTML5 History API routing with Vercel single-page app rewrites.
- **Form Submissions**: Web3Forms API endpoint integration (`api.web3forms.com`).
